meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后,只要你给出产品链接、粘贴的脚本或简报,Claude 会先确认技能更新,再抓取品牌素材、确定视觉风格、规划分镜和旁白,逐帧生成画面并合成一支产品发布或宣传视频(最终导出为 MP4)。
howto.when: 当你想宣传、发布或揭晓某产品,给出商业链接、脚本或简报等素材时;网站导览或展示类请求也会走到这里。

say.text: 用这个链接给我的新 App 做支产品发布视频
say.note: 抓取页面后规划分镜并生成 mp4

say.text: 这是我写的产品宣传稿,做成一条推广视频
say.note: 按文稿生成旁白与逐帧画面

say.text: 给我的官网做一段导览展示视频
say.note: 用页面截图逐屏展示你的网站

howto.what_en: Given a product URL, script, or brief, Claude confirms the skill update with the user, captures brand assets, sets the visual style, plans storyboard/narration, builds each frame, and renders a launch/promo video (MP4).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product and gives a commercial URL, script, or brief; website tour/showcase requests also route here.

say_en.text: Make a product launch video for my new app using this link.
say_en.note: Captures the page, plans the storyboard, and renders an MP4.

say_en.text: Here's my product copy — turn it into a promo video.
say_en.note: Builds narration and frames from the script.

say_en.text: Create a tour video of our website.
say_en.note: Shows the site screen by screen from captured shots.
